description_en: Queries the authorization information of a service account
description_zh: 该接口用于查询服务账号的授权信息
name: DescribeOperatorPermission

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26232.html operation to query the ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

CreatedTime.description_en: The effective period of the authorization. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)

ExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the authorization expires. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 授权过期时间。格式：yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz（utc时间）

Privileges.description_en:
The types of permissions that are granted. Valid values:
Control: configuration permissions. Allows you to view and modify instance configurations.
Data: database permissions. Allows you to view table schemas, indexes, and SQL statements
Privileges.description_zh:
已获取的授权类型。取值：
Control：配置权限。支持查看、修改实例配置。
Data：数据权限。支持查看表结构、索引和
 SQL
